02 / 16.05.2024 Heard the parties.
2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Chhattarpur P.S. Case No. 228 of 2023 for the offences registered under sections 366A of the Indian Penal Code and section 4 / 8 of POCSO Act and cognizance has been taken under sections 366 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code and section 4 of POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.
3. On 21.11.2023 petitioner is said to have enticed away the daughter of the Informant with the intention to marry her.
4. From the impugned order, it transpires that the statement of the victim was recorded under section 164 of the Cr. P.C. in which she has stated that she has left the lawful guardianship according to her own wish and performed court marriage with the petitioner and wants to live with the petitioner.
It appears to be a case of adolescent love affair between the parties and the prosecutrix has left the lawful guardianship according to her own wish.
5.
